text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} is studying once again,
under Io's watchful eye.
text_block_list.orig_text:
きょうも{0}は
イオに勉強を見てもらっていた。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hee hee. You've picked up a lot lately.
Let's keep up the pace and continue learning together, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
{0}君も、いろいろと覚えてきたわね。
この調子で、
私と一緒に
いろんなこと覚えていきましょうね？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: What do you want to work on today?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君、
きょうは何を教えてほしい？

text_block_list.name: Schoolboy
text_block_list.text: Miss Io!
text_block_list.orig_text: イオ先生ー！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh, one of our friends from class. Is everything going well?
Was there something in the last lesson
you had a question about?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら……
あなたは私のクラスの……
どうかしたの？
この前の授業で、わからないところでもあった？

text_block_list.name: Schoolboy
text_block_list.text:
Umm, actually I wanted to ask about something else.
You and him have been hanging out a lot lately, haven't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえ、
そうじゃなくて……
その……
最近いつもその人と一緒にいますよね？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
{0}?
You've seen us, then...
For some reason, I feel a little embarrassed now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君のこと？
見られてたのね……
なんだか恥ずかしいわ。

text_block_list.name: Schoolboy
text_block_list.text: So, umm, are you two dating?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの！
お二人は恋人同士なんですか？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Bwhuh?
Me and {0}? Dating?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ！？
私と{0}君が！？　
恋人！？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
N-no, no, no!
It's not like that! Not one bit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、違う！　違う！
私たちはそういう関係じゃないわ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I'm just tutoring him. We're teacher and student, nothing more!
Yes, that's right. That's the extent of our relationship.
Got it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は{0}君に勉強を教えてるの。
つまり先生と生徒！
そう、
それだけの関係なのよ！　
わかった！？

text_block_list.name: Schoolboy
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes, ma'am.
I'm sorry, ma'am.
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はい……
わかりました。
すみませんでした……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Whew. That caught me off guard.
How could anyone mistake us for a couple?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ～
ビックリした～
まさか、
恋人に勘違いされるなんて……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I know we pretended to be one the other day, but I guess even
sitting here tutoring you could look like it's something more
from another point of view.
text_block_list.orig_text:
前に、恋人のふりをしたことはあるけど……
ただ勉強教えてただけなのに、
そういうふうに見えちゃうのね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry!
I rejected the idea pretty harshly, didn't I?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ！
ご、
ごめんね。
あんな全力で否定しちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please don't say that.
We don't have that kind of relationship...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなこと言わないで～
私たち、
そういう関係じゃないんだし……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
R-right.
We're... just friends.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうよね……
私たち、
ただのお友達だし……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: When he thought you and I were boyfriend and girlfriend, I...
text_block_list.orig_text: 私は{0}君と恋人に間違われて──

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Well, never mind.
It's nothing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
なんでもないわ。
気にしないで。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* A boyfriend...
I've never actually dated someone before.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも……
私に恋人かぁ。
今まで恋人って、
いたことないのよ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Going out on dates, spending time together
with just the two of us...
How romantic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
恋人とデートしたり、
二人っきりですごしたり……
憧れちゃうなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but wonder sometimes what kind of person
my first boyfriend will be.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の初めての恋人って、
どんな人になるのかな？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I'd love for him to be just like you.
Someone who's kind, who I always have fun with!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君みたいに優しくて、
一緒にいて楽しい人だったら、
うれしいわ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*
Oh, geez, what am I saying?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！
やだ……
私、
なに言ってるんだろ？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
The thought just popped into my head.
Don't read too much into that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんとなく、そう思っただけで、
深い意味とかないからね！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Argh, why can't I stop blabbering?
This is mortifying!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、も～！
なんでこんなこと言っちゃったんだろ？
恥ずかしい～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Listen, {0}.
You're my student and I'm your teacher.
Now, open that book—we've still got material to cover!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私と{0}君は、
先生と生徒だから！
ほらほら、
まだきょうの授業が残ってるわよ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Until your education's complete and you can learn on your own,
I'll be here to teach you with every fiber of my being!
So let's buckle down and do our best together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君が勉強できるようになるまで、
最後まで先生として、
しっかり教えてあげるからね！
二人でがんばりましょ！
